addons.name: WhatsApp click-to-chat
addons.desc: WhatsApp buttons on quotations, orders and invoices that open WhatsApp with the message and PDF link ready.
addons.fees: None — sent from the user’s own phone (not tracked).

addons.name: WhatsApp Business integration
addons.desc: Shared WhatsApp inbox inside the ERP, linked to customers and orders; approved templates; opt-in tracking; unknown numbers become CRM leads.
addons.fees: Meta per-message fees · WhatsApp Business account · template approval by Meta.

addons.name: Automatic WhatsApp alerts
addons.desc: Order confirmed, out for delivery, invoice due and payment received — sent automatically.

addons.name: Facebook Lead Ads → CRM
addons.desc: Leads from Facebook ad forms appear instantly in CRM with source and campaign, assigned to a salesperson.
addons.fees: Meta Business account · Meta app review.

addons.name: Facebook Messenger inbox
addons.desc: Facebook page messages answered from the ERP and linked to the lead or customer.

addons.name: Instagram DMs → inbox & CRM
addons.desc: Instagram business messages in the same inbox; new enquiries become leads.
addons.fees: Instagram Professional account linked to the Facebook page.

addons.name: Instagram Lead Ads → CRM
addons.desc: Instagram ad-form leads into CRM with campaign source.

addons.name: Snapchat Lead Ads → CRM
addons.desc: Leads from Snapchat lead-generation ads into CRM with campaign source. (Snapchat offers no business-chat connection for software — ad leads only.)

addons.name: TikTok Lead Ads → CRM
addons.desc: TikTok ad-form leads into CRM.

addons.name: LinkedIn Lead Gen Forms → CRM
addons.desc: B2B leads from LinkedIn ads into CRM.

addons.name: Website & Google Ads forms → CRM
addons.desc: Website contact and quote forms create leads automatically.

addons.name: Email inbox (Microsoft 365 / Gmail)
addons.desc: Shared mailboxes connected; emails filed on the right customer or order; replies tracked.

addons.name: SMS notifications
addons.desc: Delivery and payment SMS through a UAE SMS provider.

addons.name: Telephone integration
addons.desc: Click-to-call from the ERP, calls logged on the customer, missed-call follow-ups.

addons.name: Vehicle GPS tracking
addons.desc: Live map of delivery vehicles and trip history from the GPS devices already in the vans, shown against delivery notes.
addons.fees: GPS device & tracking subscription · provider must allow data access (most do).

addons.name: Driver phone tracking (no hardware)
addons.desc: The driver app shares the phone’s location during a trip; the dispatcher sees live positions.
addons.fees: Google Maps usage · driver’s mobile data.

addons.name: Live delivery link for customers
addons.desc: The customer receives a link showing “driver on the way” and the estimated arrival time.

addons.name: Automatic arrival & proof of delivery
addons.desc: Arrival and departure at the customer site recorded by location; time-stamped on the delivery note.

addons.name: Field staff tracking
addons.desc: Sales staff, technicians and collectors check in/out with GPS and photo; visit logs against customers and leads; daily route history; linked to attendance.
addons.fees: Maps usage · staff use the mobile app.

addons.name: Field service jobs
addons.desc: Technician job cards for installation and maintenance-contract visits: checklist, photos, customer signature, spare parts used.

addons.name: Route planning
addons.desc: Best order of deliveries or visits for the day.

addons.name: Fuel & mileage log
addons.desc: Fuel entries, odometer readings and cost per km for each vehicle.

addons.name: Online payment links
addons.desc: “Pay now” link on invoices; the payment is recorded automatically.
addons.fees: Payment gateway fees (Network International, Telr, Stripe…).

addons.name: UAE e-invoicing connection
addons.desc: Invoices sent through an accredited e-invoicing provider in the national format.
addons.fees: Provider subscription · mandatory in phases from 2027.

addons.name: Bank feed
addons.desc: Bank statements imported automatically for reconciliation.

addons.name: E-commerce sync (per platform)
addons.desc: Products, stock, orders and payments synced with Shopify, WooCommerce, Amazon.ae or Noon.

addons.name: Barcode labels & scanners
addons.desc: Item and serial labels, handheld scanning for receiving and picking.

addons.name: Biometric attendance
addons.desc: Fingerprint or face devices feeding attendance and payroll.

addons.name: Management reports (Power BI / Looker)
addons.desc: Live dashboards on ERP data.

addons.name: AI order assistant
addons.desc: Reads customer emails and WhatsApp enquiries, picks out items and quantities, checks stock and price, and drafts the quotation for review.

addons.name: Supplier bill scanning
addons.desc: PDF or photo bills read into purchase invoices, with duplicate, TRN, VAT and PO / goods-receipt checks.

addons.name: AI assistant
addons.desc: Ask questions in plain English or Arabic (“overdue invoices for Al Noor”) and draft replies.

addons.name: Branded customer app
addons.desc: Customer portal as an installable app with order tracking and statements.

addons.name: Full Arabic interface
addons.desc: Every screen and print format in Arabic.
